decisions.name: 黃少谷
decisions.reason: Actual original 2457x2448 JPEG inspected: single singer with clear source caption, but the face occupies a modest portion of the frame, has visibly soft eyes and facial details, and is unevenly illuminated by strong purple stage lighting. Automatic crop failed 'Blurred crop: sharpness below 65'. Enlarging to 600x720 and progressive eye/nose/mouth reveal would amplify softness and color cast; seek a brighter, sharp, front-facing portrait instead.
